title: The Keyword Method for New Words
short: To learn a new word, find an English word that sounds like it, then picture the two meanings together.
trouble: Choosing a keyword that sounds alike but can't be pictured.

practice.q: Spanish perro means dog. Build a keyword picture.
practice.a: A dog chewing a giant pear (perro, dog).
steps: Sound: perro sounds a little like "pear."
Picture: a dog chewing a giant pear.
practice.title: Worked example

blocks.html: Learning words in another language? The keyword method builds a bridge in two steps.

items: Sound link: find an English word that sounds like the new word.
Picture link: make a vivid picture joining that English word with the meaning.
